title: Mysterious language again, seriously?
titleZh: 又是神秘语言，认真的吗？
statementMd:
You are given a mysterious language (codenamed "Secret 2021") available in "Custom Test" tab. Find out what this language is and write a program which outputs its name. Note that the program must be written in this language.

## Input

This program has only one test, and it's empty (it doesn't give your program anything to read).

## Output

Output the name of the mysterious language.
statementZhMd:
你将获得一种神秘语言（代号为“Secret 2021”），该语言可在“Custom Test”标签页中使用。请找出这种语言是什么，并编写一个输出其名称的程序。注意，程序必须使用这种语言编写。

## 输入

该程序只有一个测试，且测试内容为空（不会向程序提供任何需要读取的内容）。

## 输出

输出神秘语言的名称。
